MLB Batting Statistics

BattingPreview.Rd

A dataset containing MLB player batting statistics used by PlayerPredictorMLB to identify similar player seasons from 2021-2026. This is a preview of the internal data.

Usage

BattingPreview

Format

A data frame with 25 rows and 33 variables:

Name

Player name.

Team

Team the player played for during a particular season. Listed as "—" if they played for multiple teams.

G

Games played.

PA

Plate appearances.

R

Runs scored.

RBI

Runs batted in.

SB

Stolen bases.

BB%

Percentage of plate appearances where the batter walked.

K%

Percentage of plate appearances where the batter struck out.

ISO

Isolated power.

BABIP

Batting average on balls in play.

AVG

Batting average.

OBP

On-base percentage.

SLG

Slugging percentage.

wOBA

Weighted on-base average.

xwOBA

Expected weighted on-base average.

wRC+

Weighted runs created plus.

BsR

Base Running.

Off

Offensive runs above average.

Def

Defensive runs above average.

WAR

Wins above replacement.

Season

The season the stat line occurred in.

Age

The player's official age for the season.

GB%

The percentage of a batter’s balls in play that are ground balls.

HR

Home runs.

HR/FB

Ratio of home runs to fly balls.

Barrel%

Percent of a player's batted balls that are classified as a barrel.

HardHit%

Percentage of a player's batted balls that are classified as hard hit balls.

xBA

Expected batting average.

xSLG

Expected slugging percentage.

NameASCII

Player name using only ASCII characters.

PlayerId

Unique player identifier that can be used to link to other datasets that use PlayerID.

MLBAMID

Unique player identifier called Major League Baseball Advanced Media ID that can be used to link to other datasets that use MLBAMID.

Source

FanGraphs.com
